text: Declare, run, and resolve incidents from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams
quote: Declare, run, and resolve an incident from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams.

text: Create or manage a dedicated incident communication channel in Slack or Microsoft Teams
quote: Create or manage an incident communication channel (Slack or Microsoft Teams)

text: Migrate from Opsgenie or PagerDuty, bringing schedules and escalation policies without rebuilding them
quote: Bring your schedules, escalation policies, and more without a rebuild.

text: On-call schedules with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews
quote: Create, manage, and maintain on-call schedules in Rootly with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews to keep coverage clear and predictable.

text: Schedules can range from a single weekly rotation to nested schedules representing teams or geographies
quote: A schedule can be as simple as a single user rotating weekly, or as complex as multiple schedules nested within one another, representing different teams or geographies.

text: Rotations support holidays, PTO, and shadowing
quote: Rotations built in minutes, with holidays, PTO, and shadowing

text: Shift swaps and overrides can be done from mobile
quote: Mobile shift swaps and overrides

text: Escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin so alerts get acknowledged
quote: Configure Rootly escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin to make sure on-call alerts get acknowledged and acted on.

text: Live Call Routing provides a phone number that connects callers to the on-call responder or takes a message and pages them
quote: Live Call Routing gives your team a phone number that pages the right person. A caller dials the number, Rootly figures out who's on call, and either connects the two live or takes a message and pages the on-call responder.

text: Repeat events from the same monitor collapse into one open alert via a stable identifier so responders aren't paged twice
quote: Collapse repeat events from the same monitor into a single open Rootly alert using a stable identifier, so responders aren't paged twice.

text: Ingest alerts from tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, and Sentry, then deduplicate, group related alerts, and route them to teams
quote: Alerts arrive programmatically from monitoring tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, or Sentry... Rootly deduplicates repeats, groups related alerts together, routes each one to the right team

text: Alert Routes send incoming alerts to teams, services, and escalation policies based on conditions you define
quote: Use Alert Routes to determine which teams, services, and escalation policies receive incoming alerts from your monitoring tools based on conditions you define.

text: Routing conditions can evaluate alert sources, normalized alert fields, raw payload values via JSONPath, teams, and services
quote: It supports evaluation against: Alert Sources, Alert Fields (normalized metadata), Raw payload values (JSONPath), Teams, services, and escalation policies

text: Set, read, and clear a direct notification target on email alert sources
quote: set, read, and clear a direct notification target on email alert sources with notification_target_type and notification_target_id

text: API lets you create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, and other automation
quote: The Rootly API allows you to create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, internal services, or any external automation system.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specification for the Rootly API, usable for generating client libraries
quote: API overview: "Download OpenAPI Specification" linking https://rootly.com/swagger/v1/swagger.json — "Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries." (The swagger.json URL itself

text: API changelog tracks new endpoints, deprecations, and breaking changes with dated entries
quote: "API Changelog: Track the latest changes, deprecations, and breaking updates to the Rootly API, including new endpoints, payload changes, and version release notes", with dated entries such as October 6, 2026: "breaking: POST /v1/incidents/

text: Generate API keys from organization settings
quote: To generate a new API key, navigate to: **Organization dropdown** > **Organization Settings** > **API Keys > Generate New API Key**.

text: Global API keys are assigned specific On-Call and Incident Response roles when generated
quote: Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when they’re generated.

text: Incident timeline combines updates from people, systems, automations, and chat channels into one chronological record
quote: The incident timeline is the authoritative record of what happened during an incident. It brings together updates from people, systems, automations, and communication channels into one clear, chronological narrative.

text: Retrospective sections like Summary, Impact, Root Cause, and Timeline are auto-drafted from incident data, Slack, and call transcripts
quote: sections like Summary, Impact, Root Cause, Mitigation, Resolution, and Curated Timeline get drafted automatically from the incident's data, Slack channel, and bridge-call transcripts

text: Define multiple retrospective processes and route each incident to one by severity, type, or team
quote: Rootly lets you define multiple processes and route each incident to the right one based on severity, type, or team, so a SEV0 gets full formal treatment while a SEV3 gets a lightweight review.

text: Drive retrospective follow-ups through configurable step-by-step processes
quote: Right-size retrospective processes by severity, type, or team; auto-draft with Rootly AI; and drive follow-ups through configurable step-by-step processes.

text: Retrospective rich text editor with live incident data and real-time multi-author collaboration
quote: Rootly includes a rich text editor in retrospectives that supports live incident data and real-time collaboration - all without leaving the platform.

text: Retrospective editor supports dynamic data blocks, Liquid variables, and inline action item tracking
quote: Explore the Rootly collaborative retrospective editor with real-time co-authoring, dynamic data blocks, Liquid variables, and inline action item tracking.

text: Export retrospective drafts from the Rootly editor to an external editor
quote: Many teams use a hybrid approach by drafting in the Rootly document editor and exporting a copy to their external editor of choice.

text: AI blocks in the retrospective editor draft sections like What Happened or Contributing Factors from incident context
quote: AI blocks solve the blank-page problem. Inside the Rootly retrospective editor, an AI block is a section, such as What Happened or Contributing Factors, that Rootly AI drafts for you from the incident's own context.

text: Retrospective templates include AI blocks so every retrospective from the template generates those sections automatically
quote: You decide which blocks belong in a retrospective by adding them to a template, and every retrospective created from that template generates those sections automatically.

text: Preview AI block output against a past incident before rolling out a template
quote: Add Rootly AI blocks to a retrospective template and preview the output against a past incident before rollout.

text: Inspect sources of AI blocks, and edit, regenerate, convert, or rate their output
quote: Insert Rootly AI blocks in a retrospective, watch them generate, inspect their sources, and edit, regenerate, convert, or rate the output.

text: Workflow automation engine runs actions automatically or manually based on trigger events and run conditions
quote: Workflows are Rootly's automation engine. They let you run structured actions automatically (or manually) based on: **Trigger events**... **Run conditions**... **Actions**

text: 152 workflow action types across Slack, Google Chat, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations
quote: Reference for all 152 Rootly workflow action types, grouped by category: Slack, Google Chat, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations.

text: Automation creates channels, updates stakeholders, files tickets, and starts retros consistently
quote: Automation that runs your response: channels created, stakeholders updated, tickets filed, retros started, the same way every time.

text: Many text fields support Liquid templating with dynamic incident, alert, or on-call values
quote: Many text fields support Liquid templating for dynamic values drawn from incident, alert, or on-call context.

text: Public and private status pages for communicating service health
quote: Rootly has two types of status pages available: public status pages and private status pages.

text: Status pages share system health with internal teams, customers, and partners
quote: Status pages allow you to quickly communicate information about the health of your services and applications to internal stakeholders and external customers.

text: Public JSON API on the status page custom domain for retrieving current status and incident data
quote: Rootly exposes a public JSON API on your status page's custom domain, allowing you to programmatically retrieve current status and incident data.

text: AI Summaries write incident summaries from metadata, alerts, timeline, action items, Slack messages, and transcripts
quote: AI Summaries writes it for you, from what the incident already knows: metadata, alerts, timeline events, action items, and (when permitted) Slack messages and meeting transcripts.

text: AI-generated titles, summaries, catchups, and status write-ups from the incident record
quote: Titles, summaries, catchups, and status write-ups, generated from the incident's own record so nobody has to write documentation mid-incident.

text: Private incident catchup summary delivered to responders joining midstream
quote: Incident catchup: The summary, expanded and delivered privately to responders joining midstream. Only you see it.

text: Live AI summary and key moments pinned in Slack for every incident (early access)
quote: A live AI summary and the key moments of every incident, pinned in Slack. Now in early access.

text: Meeting Scribe joins incident bridges and transcribes them live with speaker labels, attached to the incident
quote: The scribe joins your incident bridges, transcribes them live with speaker labels, and turns the call into a record your whole team can use.

text: Meeting recordings can store speakers anonymized as Responder A, B, C labels
quote: **feat:** expose `speakers_anonymized` on meeting recordings, true when the recording stores speakers as Responder A, B, C labels instead of names

text: Read-only AI chat on the web incident page answers natural-language questions grounded in timeline, alerts, chat, and transcripts
quote: Open it on any incident and ask questions in natural language. Answers are grounded in that incident's live context: its timeline, alerts, chat history, and bridge-call transcripts.

text: Rootly AI in Slack answers questions from Rootly data and takes actions, confirming destructive actions first
quote: Rootly AI in Slack answers questions grounded in your Rootly data and takes actions on your behalf, confirming destructive actions before they fire.

text: Natural-language commands in Slack to change severity, page teams, or convert to a private incident
quote: "This is now a SEV1. Update the incident severity." ... "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident."

text: Rootly AI can create on-call overrides, look up who's on call, and create retrospectives
quote: Rootly AI can now create overrides, look up who's on call, create retrospectives, and answer questions about Rootly.

text: AI Instructions configure how Rootly agents carry out tasks to match team practices
quote: AI Instructions guide Rootly Agents on how to carry out tasks and respond to requests, so every automated interaction works the way your teams do.

text: Mobile app shows an Incident Summary card and Rootly AI chat on any incident, with the same privacy controls as web and Slack
quote: Get an Incident Summary card and the Rootly AI chat on your phone while on-call, with the same privacy controls as the web and Slack experiences.

text: Official MCP server exposes Rootly incident data and actions as tools for MCP clients
quote: The Rootly MCP Server implements the Model Context Protocol to expose Rootly incident data and actions as tools that any MCP-compatible client can use.

text: Query incidents, check on-call schedules, find similar incidents, and take action from Cursor, Claude Code, and other MCP clients
quote: you can query incidents, check on-call schedules, find similar past incidents, and take action — all from within Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or any other MCP-compatible environment.

text: MCP server tools are generated dynamically from the OpenAPI spec to mirror the current API surface
quote: The server dynamically generates tools from Rootly's OpenAPI specification, so it always reflects the current API surface.

text: MCP find_related_incidents tool uses TF-IDF similarity to surface similar past incidents
quote: **`find_related_incidents`** — uses TF-IDF similarity analysis to surface historically similar incidents

text: Rootly AI matches current incidents against previously solved incidents
quote: Rootly AI matches your incident against everything your team already solved.

text: AI SRE investigates alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives a reviewable diagnosis
quote: Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.

text: AI SRE analyzes code changes, telemetry, and past incidents to identify root causes and fixes
quote: Rootly AI SRE analyzes your code changes, telemetry, and past incidents to quickly identify root causes and the fix, even if you don't know that code.

text: AI SRE produces remediation steps and draft pull requests
quote: Remediation steps and draft PRs

text: Investigation rules choose which alerts AI SRE investigates automatically, with preview against recent alerts
quote: Investigation rules decide which alerts Rootly AI SRE investigates automatically and which alert-specific instructions it applies

text: AI SRE learns context notes from investigations, with controls over which ones it recalls
quote: Review the context notes Rootly AI SRE learns from investigations and past incidents, and control which ones it recalls in later investigations.

text: Admin governance for Rootly AI: team opt-in, per-feature toggles, AI SRE access, and connector read/write permissions
quote: Govern Rootly AI from AI & Agents: the team-wide opt-in, per-feature toggles, AI SRE access, and what each connector can read or change.
